title: Raaves
summary: A location-based app for discovering nearby merchants and hotels through audio and video reviews from real visitors. I built the backend APIs with Django REST Framework.
highlights: Audio and video reviews, stored on AWS S3
Real-time chat between users
Follow, block and unblock to control who you interact with

title: Glovendor
summary: A social platform for sharing content with a global audience, with premium Content+ posts unlocked through event-based subscriptions.
highlights: Content+ posts reviewed by admins before they go live
Event-based subscriptions and an in-app wallet with transaction history
PayPal top-ups and real-time chat

title: VPOS
summary: A point-of-sale system integrated with Linkly, so businesses can create invoices and take cash, credit and debit card payments in one place.
highlights: Card payments through Linkly, alongside cash
Pay or refund several invoices in one batch
Asynchronous payment handling with automatic PDF invoices

title: Cancer Warrior Health
summary: A platform that helps cancer patients and survivors manage daily health and diet plans, during treatment and into recovery. I built the backend APIs.
highlights: Personal goals and daily routines
Health and diet plans created or approved by doctors
Support that continues after treatment ends

title: Demand Forecasting
summary: Sales forecasting models that predict demand from historical sales data, built to improve inventory and business planning.
highlights: EDA and feature engineering on sales trends and seasonality
Compared Decision Tree, Random Forest, ARIMA/SARIMA and LSTM models
Tuned hyperparameters and features for better accuracy

title: Object Detection & Counting
summary: A computer-vision system that detects and counts objects in real time, served through a Django API with a React dashboard.

title: Customer Churn Prediction
summary: A deep learning model that predicts which customers are likely to leave, so retention efforts can target them early.
highlights: EDA and feature engineering to find the behaviour behind churn
Neural network in TensorFlow and Keras
Hyperparameter tuning for better accuracy

title: Telegram Chatbot
summary: An AI chatbot built with Dialogflow and connected to Telegram to answer users automatically.
highlights: Intents and entities designed for natural conversations
Keeps context across messages for more relevant replies
Response flows tuned for fast, accurate answers

title: Barcode PDF Processing
summary: Finds and reads barcodes in scanned PDFs, then splits, renames and uploads the files automatically.
highlights: Splits PDFs at each detected barcode
OpenCV clean-up and OCR to read barcode values
Renamed files uploaded to an FTP server

title: PDF Data Extraction & Upload
summary: Extracts key data from PDF documents and enters it into a website automatically, replacing manual data entry.
highlights: Parses structured and unstructured data from PDFs
Selenium automation uploads the data to the target website
Error handling with email alerts when something fails

title: API to SFTP Data Pipeline
summary: A Python pipeline that fetches data from a REST API, transforms it with business rules and delivers it securely over SFTP.
highlights: API fetching with retries and error handling
Cleaning, filtering and reshaping with pandas
SFTP upload with Paramiko, email alerts and step-by-step logging

title: Bulk CSV to MSSQL Loader
summary: A high-performance script that loads very large CSV files into Microsoft SQL Server without running out of memory.
highlights: Reads CSVs in 5,000-row chunks with pandas
Applies row and column rules, then builds parameterised inserts
Bulk inserts with pyodbc in a single transaction
